whole_CRT_section.name: .CRT$XCU
whole_CRT_section.source_fixup: one DIR32 to local genuine initializer code

sentinels.scan_domain: strictly start+4 through end-4, aligned4 only

recommended_negative_controls: Duplicate true target at another aligned table slot must fail uniqueness; never choose one.
Wrong target or pointer outside sentinel interval must not bind.
Missing linked PE relocation must fail despite identical pointer bytes.
Wrong sentinel CRT owner or non-null sentinel must fail boundary qualification.
limit: This only proves address identification; retain standard full-region comparison and every original/linked relocation gate. No broader raw-pointer search.
